description: This Swift source file defines a SwiftUI View named `VoiceWakeSettings`, which provides a user interface for configuring voice wake features on macOS. It manages microphone selection, recognition language settings, trigger words, sound options, and testing functionalities for voice wake detection.

classes.name: VoiceWakeSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for managing voice wake configuration, including microphone selection, trigger words, recognition language, and test controls. It dynamically loads available input devices and languages, handles user interactions, and interfaces with sound and recognition utilities.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: Represents an audio input device with a unique identifier and name.

classes.name: TriggerEntry
classes.description: Represents a trigger word entry with a unique id and the trigger text.

methods.name: loadTriggerEntries
methods.description: Loads trigger words from the application state into the local triggerEntries array.

methods.name: syncTriggerEntriesToState
methods.description: Synchronizes the local triggerEntries array back to the application state.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a new empty trigger word entry.

methods.name: removeWord
methods.description: Removes a trigger word entry by its UUID.

methods.name: selectChime
methods.description: Sets the selected chime sound and plays it.

methods.name: chooseCustomChime
methods.description: Opens a file dialog to select a custom audio file for a chime, and updates the selected chime.

methods.name: sanitizedTriggers
methods.description: Returns a sanitized list of trigger words, suitable for use.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Creates a command string from a transcript if it contains trigger words, using specific rules.

methods.name: loadMicsIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads available microphone devices asynchronously, optionally forcing reload.

methods.name: updateSelectedMicName
methods.description: Updates the application state with the name of the currently selected microphone.

methods.name: startMicObserver
methods.description: Starts observing for microphone device changes.

methods.name: scheduleMicRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a refresh of microphone list and restart of the level meter.

methods.name: loadLocalesIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads supported speech recognition locales asynchronously.

methods.name: friendlyName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable name for a given locale, normalizing identifiers.

methods.name: restartMeter
methods.description: Restarts the microphone level meter and updates level display.
